# Renters — Find Rooms, Flats, Houses & Halls

> Renters is a platform for finding, renting, and buying verified residential and commercial properties.

## Primary Directories & Services
- Rent Listings: https://renters-l7dz.onrender.com/rent
- Buy Listings: https://renters-l7dz.onrender.com/buy
- Post Property: https://renters-l7dz.onrender.com/post-property
- Contact & Support: https://renters-l7dz.onrender.com/contact
- Frequently Asked Questions: https://renters-l7dz.onrender.com/faq

## Platform Capabilities
- Real-Time AI Property Assistant
- Interactive Map & Neighborhood Analytics
- Virtual Video Tours & 360 Degree Panoramas
- Landlord & Property Owner Verification
- DRM Content Protection & Instant Lead Messaging
